<!-- Source page: Taskserver -->

Taskserver is the server component of version 2 of <a href="Taskwarrior" class="wikilink" title="Taskwarrior">Taskwarrior</a>, a free and open source todo list application. Starting from version 3 of Taskwarrior sync is not done via Taskserver anymore: see [1](https://taskwarrior.org/docs/upgrade-3/).

Taskserver is documented in the [NixOS manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/#module-services-taskserver).
